responsibility: This Texinfo file contains the EBNF-style grammar reference for the GNU Modula-2 language accepted by the GM2 front end. It enumerates productions for lexical classes, declarations, types, expressions, modules, procedures, exception blocks, attributes, builtins, and GNU extensions such as inline assembly and builtin attributes, using `@findex` entries to make grammar nonterminals searchable in the manual; its role is to publish the parser-level language syntax rather than library APIs or runtime behavior.
